input: Get the roof inspected before winter

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The type of property and roof material affects what kind of inspector is needed and what they should look for.
Knowing whether the user already has a contractor in mind or needs to find one entirely changes the first steps of the plan.
The deadline before winter varies greatly by location — knowing how many weeks are realistically available shapes urgency and scheduling.
A fixed budget determines whether to get multiple quotes, and whether minor repairs found during inspection can be addressed immediately.
The user may want a purely visual check, a full structural assessment, or an inspection that also covers gutters, flashing, and skylights — this changes what to request.
Understanding what outcome the user needs — a written report, a contractor sign-off, or peace of mind before a home sale — defines what 'done well' looks like.
Knowing whether the user wants to book online, call local contractors, or use a home-warranty service determines the immediate next action.

gold.taskTitle: Get roof inspected before winter arrives
gold.taskDescription: Arrange and complete a professional roof inspection on the user's property before winter weather sets in.

questions.title: What type of roof do you have on the property?
questions.description: Understanding the roof material (shingle, tile, flat, metal, etc.) and property type helps identify the right kind of inspector and what issues to prioritise.

questions.title: Do you have an inspector or contractor already in mind?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user has an existing relationship with a roofer, or needs to search from scratch, determines whether the first step is research or simply scheduling.

questions.title: When does winter typically arrive in your area?
questions.description: The realistic deadline — whether it is 3 weeks or 3 months away — sets the urgency level and how aggressively to pursue booking.

questions.title: What is your budget for the inspection itself?
questions.description: A clear budget determines whether to collect multiple quotes, and whether to budget for immediate minor repairs found during the visit.

questions.title: Should the inspection cover gutters, flashing, and skylights too?
questions.description: Defining scope upfront ensures the right inspection package is requested and nothing critical is missed or unexpectedly added to the bill.

questions.title: What does a successful inspection outcome look like to you?
questions.description: The user may need a written report for insurance, a contractor's sign-off before a home sale, or simply personal reassurance — this shapes what to ask the inspector to provide.

questions.title: How do you prefer to find and book the inspector?
questions.description: Whether the user prefers searching online review platforms, calling local contractors directly, or using a home-warranty or insurance referral determines the immediate next action.
